label: Referral
description: A source matter has been referred. Enforcement must accept or decline the referral.

label: Assessment
description: Enforcement assesses the referred matter and the supporting evidence.

label: Notice issued
description: A formal notice has been issued to the entity.

label: Representations
description: The entity may make representations before a decision is taken.

label: Decision
description: The decision maker weighs the evidence and representations.

label: Sanction / directive
description: The sanction or directive flowing from the decision is imposed.

label: Remediation monitoring
description: Obligations, remediation evidence and penalty settlement are monitored.

label: Appeal
description: An appeal against the enforcement decision is under review.
